review_policy: Learner-facing and strategic approval requires explicit independent human review. Deterministic checks may reject stale, invalid, or out-of-scope mutations but can never create an approval.

final_composition.note: Gauntlet 4, final shell cleanup, bounded post-integration workflow-integrity repairs, the Wave C bilingual test-invite gate, v1.2.0 release identity, the N1 novice-scaffold learner composition, FINAL N2 novice-clarity repairs, the final bounded comprehension closure, the exact source-lock closure, and the final low-risk plus-EV clarity cleanup are materialized in the review corpus. The current bounded tester-profile repair isolates local learner state when a verified tester code changes and adds explicit full-progress deletion in Data & Recovery. The bounded post-tester scroll-continuity repair preserves the learner viewport and stable focus anchor when the already-answered Cold Check walkthrough or the lab prediction check is revealed; it changes presentation continuity only. The bounded card-SRS continuity repair clarifies that the two-minute label describes the warm-up session, while the scheduling implementation preserves the existing card intervals and due-time contract. The real-use decision-transfer repair restores concrete, explicitly scoped hand/board representatives where the current admitted corpus already supports the mechanism, removes obvious wrong-answer wording tells across the final RU/EN drill corpus, and balances option length so correctness is not signalled by prose length. The final learning-integrity closure removes the remaining material prompt-to-answer leakage, repairs the remaining material distractor-parity clusters, and adds an explicit LCM-02 starting-hand family/traits scaffold with 76s/98s sibling recognition plus contextual A5s transfer. The stimulus-generalisation micro-closure adds exactly two ordinary LCM-02 Cards/SRS retrieval stimuli, fresh 87s and A4s, so the learner must independently classify an unseen suited connector and suited wheel ace by family and traits; neither card adds an exact poker action. The bounded real-use feedback repair collapses only an exact duplicate selected/working action-reason pair in the fallback feedback surface; any real mismatch remains visible for comparison. The evidence-backed full learner-language polish normalizes the final assembled RU/EN corpus after all semantic overlays, removes recurring hybrid architecture jargon exposed by real use, and repairs high-friction decision and worked-example guidance copy without changing stable module/drill/card/option IDs, correct answers, misconception mapping, scoring, mastery, scheduler, retention, field evidence or learner state. Explain-back UI cleanup is presentation-only. Strategy, drills, exact RU/EN human review and final composition approval remain pending; deterministic source locks, CI and machine/agent review are rejection evidence only and are not human approval.
